svg.title: Continuous Registration (Ramsay–Li)
svg.desc: Top row: the warp is built from a B-spline expansion W = sum of c_k phi_k (first coefficient fixed at 0), exponentiated to be positive, and integrated and normalised, so h(t) = a + (b minus a) F(t)/F(b) is smooth and strictly increasing. Bottom row: if the registered curve is 2 times the target, the points (y0, y-hat) lie on a line, the 2 by 2 cross-product matrix is singular and the minimum-eigenvalue criterion is 0, while the least-squares residual stays positive.
svg.text: Smooth strictly monotone warps from exp W; min-eigenvalue criterion ignores amplitude scale
LS would warp to fix amplitude
